project_admin.purpose: Privileged provisioning, schema ownership, SECURITY DEFINER ownership

scs_migration.purpose: Optional ordered DDL apply after roles exist; NOT SUPERUSER/CREATEROLE by default

scs_owner_admin.purpose: Owner monitoring / retention RPCs; never Function runtime

scs_test_admin.purpose: Separate test-administration identity for fixture setup only

process: 1. Connect as controlled project administrator (DATABASE_PROJECT_ADMIN_URL / postgres).
3. Optionally CREATE ROLE scs_test_admin for fixtures (LOGIN NOINHERIT; not Function runtime).
4. Apply migrations 001→007 in order as project admin (preferred) or scs_migration without elevating it.
5. Confirm SECURITY DEFINER functions and schema objects are owned by project admin.
6. Confirm runtime grants match 007 (intake / notify / owner_admin only as granted).
7. Set passwords out of band; wire Netlify secrets to least-privilege URLs only.
